arxiv-2209-06551.title: On the complex valued metric-like spaces
arxiv-2209-06551.creator: A. Hosseini and M. Mohammadzadeh Karizaki
arxiv-2209-06551.description:
A 2022 arXiv research paper by A. Hosseini and M. Mohammadzadeh Karizaki. The main purpose of this paper is to study complex valued metric-like spaces as an extension of metric-like spaces, complex valued partial metric spaces, partial metric spaces, complex valued metric spaces and metric spaces. In this article, the concepts such as quasi-equal points, completely separate points, convergence of a sequence, Cauchy sequence, cluster points and complex diameter of a set are defined in a complex valued metric-like space. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification

arxiv-2210-12310.title: Tools for Extracting Spatio-Temporal Patterns in Meteorological Image Sequences: From Feature Engineering to Attention-Based Neural Networks Publication type: UNDER REVIEW - AS SURVEY ARTICLE Journal: Environmental Data Science
arxiv-2210-12310.creator: *, Yoonjin Lee, Kyle Hilburn, Imme Ebert-Uphoff
arxiv-2210-12310.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by *, Yoonjin Lee, Kyle Hilburn, Imme Ebert-Uphoff. Atmospheric processes involve both space and time. This is why human analysis of atmospheric imagery can often extract more information from animated loops of image sequences than from individual images. Automating such an analysis requires the ability to identify spatio-temporal patterns in image sequences which is a very challenging task, because of the endless possibilities of patterns in both space and time.

arxiv-2303-04828.title: Orbital support and evolution of flat profiles of bars (shoulders) numpy ( Harris et al. 2020 ) , scipy ( Virtanen et al. 2020 ) , pynbody ( Pontzen et al. 2013 ) , Agama ( Vasiliev 2019 ) , naif (this work).
arxiv-2303-04828.creator: Leandro Beraldo e Silva, Victor P. Debattista, Stuart Robert Anderson, Monica Valluri, Peter Erwin, Kathryne J. Daniel, Nathan Deg
arxiv-2303-04828.description: Abstract Many barred galaxies exhibit upturns (shoulders) in their bar major-axis density profile. Simulation studies have suggested that shoulders are supported by looped x 1 x_{1} orbits, occur in growing bars, and can appear after bar-buckling. We investigate the orbital support and evolution of shoulders via frequency analyses of orbits in simulations.

arxiv-2307-13046.title: Skydiving to Bootstrap Islands
arxiv-2307-13046.creator: Aike Liu, David Simmons-Duffin, Ning Su, Balt C. van Rees
arxiv-2307-13046.description: Abstract We study families of semidefinite programs (SDPs) that depend nonlinearly on a small number of “external” parameters. Such families appear universally in numerical bootstrap computations. The traditional method for finding an optimal point in parameter space works by first solving an SDP with fixed external parameters, then moving to a new point in parameter space and repeating the process.

arxiv-2401-09004.title: Stability analysis of f ⁡ ( Q ) f(Q) gravity models using Dynamical Systems
arxiv-2401-09004.creator: Pooja Vishwakarma, Parth Shah
arxiv-2401-09004.description: Abstract In recent years, the modified theory of gravity known as f ⁡ ( Q ) f(Q) gravity has drawn interest as a potential alternative to general relativity. According to this theory, the gravitational force is determined by a function of the so-called “non-metricity” tensor Q Q , which expresses how far a particle space-time is from the metric geometry.

arxiv-2508-19188.title: FastMesh : Efficient Artistic Mesh Generation via Component Decoupling
arxiv-2508-19188.creator: Jeonghwan Kim, Yushi Lan, Armando Fortes, Yongwei Chen, Xingang Pan
arxiv-2508-19188.description: Abstract Recent mesh generation approaches typically tokenize triangle meshes into sequences of tokens and train autoregressive models to generate these tokens sequentially. Despite substantial progress, such token sequences inevitably reuse vertices multiple times to fully represent manifold meshes, as each vertex is shared by multiple faces. This redundancy leads to excessively long token sequences and inefficient generation processes.

arxiv-2509-26262.title: Analyzing BEV Suitability and Charging Strategies Using Italian Driving Data

arxiv-2509-26262.description: Abstract Battery Electric Vehicles (BEVs) are rapidly evolving from a niche alternative to an established option for private transportation, often replacing Internal Combustion Engine (ICE) vehicles. Despite growing interest, significant barriers remain, including range anxiety, the inconvenience associated with public charging stations, and higher costs.

pmc-10480477.description: Hematopoietic progenitors are enriched in the endocardial cushion and contribute, in a Nkx2-5-dependent manner, to tissue macrophages required for the remodeling of cardiac valves and septa. Cardiopulmonary exercise testing (CPET) is a tool used to assess patients’ cardiac and respiratory fitness, and the patient’s ability to withstand the rigor of extensive surgery.

pmc-10653422.description: BackgroundSatisfaction of fundamental needs is an important concept in sport, but currently there is no tool in Arabic to measure this construct. pmc-11286968.title: A new genus and species of nudibranch-mimicking Syllidae (Annelida, Polychaeta)
pmc-11286968.creator: Naoto Jimi, Temir A. Britayev, Misato Sako, Sau Pinn Woo, Daniel Martin
pmc-11286968.description: Nudibranch mollusks, which are well-known for their vivid warning coloration and effective defenses, are mimicked by diverse invertebrates to deter predation through both Müllerian and Batesian strategies. Despite extensive documentation across different taxa, mimickers have not been detected among annelids, including polychaetes, until now.

pmc-11357271.creator: Fern Jenkins, Tobias Mapulanga, Gauri Thapa, Kelly A S da Costa, Nigel J Temperton, Tian Wang
pmc-11357271.description: The emergence of SARS-CoV-2 has meant that pandemic preparedness has become a major focus of the global scientific community. Gathered in the historic St Edmund Hall college in Oxford, the one-day LPMHealthcare conference on emerging viruses (6 September 2023) sought to review and learn from past pandemics—the current SARS-CoV-2 pandemic and the Mpox outbreak—and then look towards potential future pandemics.

pmc-12787880.description: In froth flotation, the features of froth images are important information to predict the concentrate grade. pmc-13183924.title: Arachidonate lipoxygenase 5 metabolism axis promoting ferroptosis: a potential druggable target for doxorubicin-induced cardiomyopathy
pmc-13183924.creator: Lu Chen, Xingang Sun, Han Zhang, Xuan Zhang, Mairedan Muhetarijiang, Zuoshi Wen, Chenxi Li, Mengjia Chen, Zhangquan Ying, Shuai Yuan, Liangrong Zheng, Ting Chen
pmc-13183924.description: BackgroundDoxorubicin (Dox) is a widely-used anthracycline drug for various cancers, but its clinical application is limited due to cardiotoxicity. Targeting ferroptosis is a new and effective strategy for treating Dox-induced cardiomyopathy (DIC). The arachidonate lipoxygenase 5 (ALOX5) metabolism axis is closely linked to ferroptosis, but its role in DIC remains unknown.

pmc-13242782.creator: Steven Henikoff, Steven Hahn
pmc-13242782.description: How genes respond to external signals is poorly understood, with transcription factors and histones proposed as mediators of signals to RNA polymerase II (Pol II).
